title: Borrower Communications | Statements, Notices & Servicing Contact | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: How Veteran Loan Servicing handles borrower communications for commercial loans: statements, payment notices, and documented servicing contact with an audit trail.
lede: Borrowers are the counterparties who keep a loan performing. Clear, consistent, documented communication reduces disputes and preserves the lender relationship.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Borrowers receive statement cycles and payment-related notices on a regular schedule. Servicing contact is handled by our team and recorded, so a lender can see what was communicated and when.
bullets: Escalation into workout when terms are broken

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Communications tied to a loan are recorded in the servicing trail. Delinquency notices follow a defined sequence rather than ad-hoc outreach.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: The communication trail is available to lenders on request and supports the documentation examiners and LPs expect around delinquency handling.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: Documented, consistent borrower contact shortens the distance between a missed payment and a resolution — and removes the 'what did the servicer actually say' ambiguity.

faqs.a: Our servicing team handles borrower contact directly, with the interaction recorded in the servicing trail — not routed through an anonymous ticket queue.
Yes. Communications tied to a loan are recorded so a lender can see what was communicated and when.

faqs.q: Do you communicate with residential borrowers?
faqs.a: No. Veteran Loan Servicing services commercial real estate and business/commercial loans only.
